label: Treasure Hunter
tooltip: Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt, and lines to coffers and carrots.

enable_shared_maps.label: Share chest locations
enable_shared_maps.tooltip: Downloads coffer, carrot and pot chest locations and pot timers found by other BOCCHI players, and sends in the ones you find. Nothing about you or your character is sent, only where the chest was. Without it, BOCCHI uses only the locations it comes with.

draw_line_to_bronze_chests.label: Lines to bronze coffers
draw_line_to_bronze_chests.tooltip: Draw a brown line to bronze coffers near you. Hidden while you fight.

draw_line_to_silver_chests.label: Lines to silver coffers
draw_line_to_silver_chests.tooltip: Draw a silver line to silver coffers near you. Hidden while you fight.

draw_line_to_carrots.label: Lines to carrots
draw_line_to_carrots.tooltip: Draw a green line to carrots near you. Hidden while you fight.

return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.label: Cast Return after hunt
return_to_base_camp_after_hunt.tooltip: Cast Return when a Treasure Hunt or Carrot Hunt finishes. With Loop Carrot Hunt on, Return waits until you stop the loop.

loop_carrot_hunt.label: Loop Carrot Hunt
loop_carrot_hunt.tooltip: Keeps going round the carrot spots until you press Stop or run out of Fortune Carrots, instead of going round once.

carrot_hunt_scout_without_item.label: Scout without Fortune Carrots
carrot_hunt_scout_without_item.tooltip: Lets the Carrot Hunt start with no Fortune Carrots: it walks the route to see which carrots are there. Without it, you need at least one Fortune Carrot, and the hunt stops when you run out.

play_sound_on_hunt_complete.label: Play sound when Treasure Hunt finishes

hunt_complete_sound.label: Hunt finished sound
hunt_complete_sound.tooltip: Click a name to hear it.
hunt_complete_sound.open_folder: Open the sound folder. Put your own MP3 files there to add them.

cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.label: Cast Treasure Sight during hunt
cast_treasure_sight_during_hunt.tooltip: Cast Treasure Sight at the start and every few locations. The hunt ends early when it shows nothing is left.

hunt_max_level.label: Max coffer level
hunt_max_level.tooltip: Coffers guarded by enemies above this level are skipped. 50 = skip nothing.

hunt_min_bronze_percent.label: Min bronze remaining to auto-hunt (%)
hunt_min_bronze_percent.tooltip: Auto treasure hunts start when at least this share of the 30 bronze coffers is left, or when enough silver is left. Used by Illegal Mode and Mob Farmer.

hunt_min_silver_percent.label: Min silver remaining to auto-hunt (%)
hunt_min_silver_percent.tooltip: Auto treasure hunts start when at least this share of the 8 silver coffers is left, or when enough bronze is left. Used by Illegal Mode and Mob Farmer.

skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.label: Skip dangerous weather / Ashkin
skip_unsafe_treasure_windows.tooltip: Pause the Treasure Hunt in South Horn during Ashkin or other dangerous weather, and continue when it is over.

use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.label: Ninja Hide near strong enemies
use_ninja_hide_on_dangerous_routes.tooltip: Near a strong enemy, switch to Ninja, use Hide and walk the last part unseen. Used by Treasure Hunt, Carrot Hunt and pot chests.

use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.label: Occult Sprint while Hidden
use_occult_sprint_while_hidden.tooltip: While hidden, switch to Phantom Thief and use Occult Sprint.

ninja_gearset_number.label: Ninja gearset number
ninja_gearset_number.tooltip: The number of your Ninja gearset in the gearset list. 0 = don't switch gear. You then have to be on Ninja already.
